bear.story: AI capex digestion plus permitting friction: the Texas TCEQ freeze drags on past the Oct 19 report and copycat state actions follow, the Q2-style 'timing' slip repeats, deferred revenue starts falling as deposits reverse and cash flow turns weak; FY28 EPS ~$9 and the stock trades ~16-17x, near the 52-week low zone.

base.story: H2-2026 conversion delivers (Q3 guide $3.65-3.85B, consensus $1.83 at the top of guide), estimates keep drifting up (FY27 $9.16, FY28 ~$11), the multiple settles ~25x NTM in line with ETN/NVT; FCF normalizes as deposits flatten. Stock ends modestly above today.

bull.story: Nvidia DSX Ready qualification (first qualified CDU) and Vera Rubin / 800V DC content push share gains; orders disclosure returns strong, UIG onsite power benefits from grid/permit bottlenecks (behind-the-meter), FY28 EPS ~$12.5+ and the multiple holds ~32x; stock exceeds the May-2026 high.

thesis_break_reason: Below ~$145 the stock would be ~16x FY27 consensus $9.16 and ~14x my NTM EPS at the horizon, far below ETN (26.8x) and NVT (24.8x) and under the 52-week low region ($133.85 per the brief; $141.40 on Twelve Data per the supervisor). That only makes sense if earnings are actually falling: a second 'timing' revenue miss, deferred revenue declining without a revenue step-up (deposits reversing), FY27 guidance below ~$8.5, or the Texas permit freeze spreading and hyperscaler 2027 capex being cut. I keep $145 rather than the supervisor's $155 because a 66%-vol stock touched ~$221-227 twice in two months on sentiment alone, so $155 is still within reach of a pure de-rating.

reasoning: Round 2. Supervisor corrections accepted: FY27 consensus is $9.16 and rising (29 analysts; GNG Research independently counts 21 up / 3 down revisions in 30 days), so my unsupported 4% haircut is gone; NTM EPS at the horizon is 0.25xFY27+0.75xFY28, not full FY28; net cash after UIG is ~0 to +$1B at the horizon, not -$1.5B; and FCF is deposit-inflated (H1 FCF $1.58B vs +$1.82B deferred revenue), so I now value FCF on 85% conversion of adjusted net income rather than growing the $2.5B guide, and cut that method's weight to 40%. I verified the Texas TCEQ freeze (Foley, Troutman, Texas Tribune: all data-center environmental permits halted 2026-09-21, report due 10-19, no end date, following an August grid-connection freeze) and trim FY28 ~2% below the $11.19 aggregator for it. New in-lane finding the supervisor did not mention: Nvidia's DSX Ready program (2026-09-21) qualified Vertiv's 2.3MW CoolChip CDU as the first DSX Ready CDU (Vertiv release plus independent press), a modest share/positioning plus for the bull case, and capacity/hiring expansions (Ohio +45%, Ireland/NI several hundred jobs) continue. Net effect on fair value: P/E leg $262.5 -> $263.5 (higher EPS base offset by the correct NTM blend), FCF leg $258 -> $240 (deposit normalization), blend $260 -> $255. I disagree mildly with the supervisor's $262 because it ignores the FCF-quality finding it itself confirmed. Scenarios $150/$265/$410 at 25/50/25 (mean ~$272, median ~$256). Ladder: lognormal with median ~$256 and sigma ~0.57, with a slightly fatter left-middle for Texas/deposit-reversal risk and a thinner far right tail (peers at 25-27x cap re-rating); it ends close to round 1. Research limits: Alpha Vantage was rate-limited on my call, so consensus figures rely on the supervisor's retrieval plus an aggregator; X was not searched directly.
